nodes.label: Missing settings.json is created with haiku/claude defaults, no warning
nodes.rationale: A second call must not rewrite the file, and a pre-P1 file that omits dmBackend/openai defaults them silently rather than warning.

nodes.label: A malformed settings.json warns but is never overwritten on disk
nodes.rationale: loadSettings never throws and never destroys a player's file mid-edit. Invalid fields are replaced individually (a bad dmModel does not discard a valid summarizerModel) and each fallback carries a warning.

nodes.label: 'dual' and narratorModel validate as first-class settings
nodes.rationale: A non-string narratorModel or a model-less openai block falls back to the default openai config with a warning while still honoring a valid dmBackend; an unknown dmBackend falls back to 'claude'.

nodes.label: env > file > built-in default, per field, with blanks treated as unset
nodes.rationale: Each DND_OPENAI_* var overrides independently and leaves the others (and dmBackend) alone; a whitespace-only value is unset rather than an override to ''; an invalid DND_DM_BACKEND is ignored without throwing. The OPENROUTER_API_KEY convenience default only fills an apiKeyEnv nobody configured.
